name: Ammonium bromide
summary: Ammonium bromide, NH4Br, is the ammonium salt of hydrobromic acid. The chemical crystallizes in colorless prisms, possessing a saline taste; it sublimes on heating and is easily soluble in water. On exposure to air it gradually assumes a yellow color because of the oxidation of bromide (Br−) to bromine (Br2).

uses.text: Ammonium bromide is used for photography in films, plates and papers; in fireproofing of wood; in lithography and process engraving; in corrosion inhibitors; and in pharmaceutical preparations. Ammonium bromide has historically been used in limited flame-retardant formulations in the wood industry.

summaryZh: 溴化銨， 外觀為無色或白色立方結晶粉末，可通過氨與溴化氫反應製取。可溶於水、醇，丙酮，微溶於乙醚。用於醫藥鎮靜劑、照相感光劑等。

pharmacology.en: The active part is the bromide ion. It passes through the same channels in nerve cells as chloride and gradually replaces it, which makes nerve cells harder to fire and has a calming, anticonvulsant effect.
pharmacology.zh: 有活性的部分是溴離子。它會通過神經細胞中與氯離子相同的通道，並逐漸取代氯離子，使神經細胞較難放電，產生鎮靜與抗癲癇的作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 有活性的部分是溴离子。它会通过神经细胞中与氯离子相同的信道，并逐渐取代氯离子，使神经细胞较难放电，产生镇静与抗癫痫的作用。

sideEffects.en: Bromide leaves the body very slowly, so it builds up and causes bromism: drowsiness, confusion, slurred speech, loss of appetite, memory problems and a widespread acne-like rash. Severe bromism can cause delirium and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 溴離子離開身體的速度極慢，因此會累積並造成溴中毒：嗜睡、混亂、口齒不清、食慾不振、記憶問題，以及大範圍類似痤瘡的皮疹。嚴重溴中毒可能引起譫妄與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 溴离子离开身体的速度极慢，因此会累积并造成溴中毒：嗜睡、混乱、口齿不清、食欲不振、记忆问题，以及大范围类似痤疮的皮疹。严重溴中毒可能引起谵妄与精神病。

fact.en: Bromide salts were among the first medicines for epilepsy, used from the 1850s. Ammonium bromide slowly turns yellow in air as some of its bromide is freed as bromine.
fact.zh: 溴鹽是最早用於癲癇的藥物之一，自 1850 年代起便開始使用。溴化銨在空氣中會慢慢變黃，因為部分溴離子釋出成為溴。
fact.zhHans: 溴盐是最早用于癫痫的药物之一，自 1850 年代起便开始使用。溴化铵在空气中会慢慢变黄，因为部分溴离子发布成为溴。
